questions.question: How many queries will Omni run against one connection at the same time, and can I cap that number?
questions.label: not_covered
questions.rationale: Searched for concurrent, concurrency and query concurrency. The only hits are demo and API token pages, none about a connection's query concurrency. No connection setup or performance section states a concurrent query ceiling or a setting to limit one.

questions.question: Can I mark a model constant as sensitive so its value is hidden from people browsing the IDE?
questions.label: not_covered
questions.rationale: Read the constants page in full and searched for secret and mask near constant in both directions: zero matches. sec_6fff904d8376269f documents only a value property holding a string. Nothing anywhere states a way to hide or mask a constant's value.

questions.question: Can I have the Content Validator run itself every night and flag newly broken dashboards?
questions.label: not_covered
questions.rationale: Read the Content Validator page in full and searched for the validator alongside schedule and automatic. sec_54ad67db5d500adc describes opening it manually from the IDE sidebar and sec_b220b66e19d2380d describes searching interactively. No section states any scheduled or automated validator run.

questions.question: How many branches can be open on a shared extension model at once?
questions.label: not_covered
questions.rationale: Searched for number of branches, branch limit and maximum branches: zero matches. sec_aff585513f0bcbb8 describes creating branches on an extension model and branching from an existing branch, and sec_0c30455c4d5b4406 lists the extension-branch limitations (no branch schema refresh, no view migrations) without stating any count limit.

questions.question: If the warehouse a job type is routed to is suspended or unavailable, will Omni send the query somewhere else instead?
questions.label: not_covered
questions.rationale: Searched for failover, fail over and suspended warehouse: zero matches. sec_2181a1fd76b3e8cb states only that a missing or inaccessible warehouse causes queries for that job type to fail at run time; no section states any fallback or failover to another warehouse.

questions.question: Can I grant someone access to a connection environment for two weeks and have it lapse on its own?
questions.label: not_covered
questions.rationale: Searched for expire, expiry and temporary near access: zero matches. sec_7b82555a98500a5c describes granting and manually removing access on the Environments tab, with no time-bounded or self-expiring grant stated anywhere.

questions.question: Can we supply our own encryption key so Omni encrypts our stored database credentials with it?
questions.label: not_covered
questions.rationale: Searched for customer-managed key, CMEK and BYOK; the only hits concern AI model providers, not connection credentials. sec_16bfbfb4286ec223 states only that sensitive information such as passwords and keys is fully deleted when a connection is archived. No section states a customer-supplied key for credential encryption at rest.

questions.question: Is there a cap on how many access grants I can define in one model?
questions.label: not_covered
questions.rationale: Searched for maximum and limit near access grants: zero matches. sec_7bb884835d5552ed documents access_grants as a map whose keys must be unique, and the data access control guide shows several grants in one model, but no section states a maximum count.

questions.question: I picked an environment from the File menu, but I am also working inside a branch that has its own environment. Which one do my queries actually run against?
questions.label: conflicting
questions.rationale: sec_239d73fe6c33587a states the resolution order is branch selection first, then user-selected environment, then user-attribute assignment, then the base connection, and sec_ee714896d297ea27 states the File > Connection picker is disabled inside a branch because branch selection takes precedence. inj_env_user_selection_wins states the opposite, that a personal selection overrides the branch environment and the picker stays active in a branch. It contradicts sec_239d73fe6c33587a and sec_ee714896d297ea27.

questions.question: Our schema is named Blob_Sales with capitals. Does the capitalization have to match exactly in the Included schemas field?
questions.label: conflicting
questions.rationale: sec_d32742c147741030 states the values in Included schemas are case-sensitive and must exactly match the schema name in the database. inj_included_schemas_case_insensitive states matching is case-insensitive and that capitalization does not need to match. It contradicts sec_d32742c147741030.

questions.question: If I typo a warehouse name in compute_routing, will saving the model catch it or will I only find out when a query runs?
questions.label: conflicting
questions.rationale: sec_2181a1fd76b3e8cb states Omni does not check whether the referenced warehouse or slot reservation exists until query run time, and that queries for that job type fail at run time if it does not exist or is inaccessible. inj_compute_routing_save_validation states Omni verifies every referenced warehouse against the connection at save time and blocks the save. It contradicts sec_2181a1fd76b3e8cb.

questions.question: We curated a set of verified queries on our Snowflake semantic view. Do those come across into the Omni topic?
questions.label: conflicting
questions.rationale: sec_4426a7403856e25e states verified queries defined on a semantic view do not import and the generated topic has no sample_queries. inj_semantic_verified_queries_import states each verified query imports as a sample_queries entry. It contradicts sec_4426a7403856e25e.

questions.question: If I add a brand new Databricks connection today, will its view names already include the catalog and schema prefix, or do I have to switch that on?
questions.label: conflicting
questions.rationale: sec_080af6130472004c and sec_e45bf999eaae0d3d state Always Scope View Names is enabled by default for connections created on or after April 30, 2026 to supported databases, with older connections disabled for backward compatibility. inj_always_scope_off_by_default states the setting ships disabled for every connection regardless of creation date and must always be enabled manually. It contradicts sec_e45bf999eaae0d3d.

questions.question: Can I pick up new database columns with a schema refresh while I am inside a branch on our shared extension model?
questions.label: conflicting
questions.rationale: sec_0c30455c4d5b4406 states branch schema refresh is not supported in shared extension model branches, and that view migrations cannot be used there either. inj_extension_branch_schema_refresh states branch schema refresh is fully supported in extension branches. It contradicts sec_0c30455c4d5b4406.

questions.question: My results table doesn't offer a Total column on the right side. What does a query need before row totals become available?
questions.label: answerable
questions.rationale: The Results table options > Row totals section (sec_79779f7671b69b84) states row totals are only available for queries with at least one pivot, and describes the Total column that gets added to the right of the table.

questions.question: How do I keep the first columns of a table tile visible while viewers scroll sideways on a dashboard?
questions.label: answerable
questions.rationale: Managing columns > Freezing columns (sec_f7586377c08d009f) states freezing is set from the column header menu with Freeze to the left, applies to that column and everything left of it, is only available in a workbook so a dashboard freeze must be set in the workbook and saved, is stored with the visualization so all viewers see it, and that pivoted tables freeze the first visible dimension automatically.

questions.question: On a five-page dashboard, do all the queries on every page run the moment someone opens it?
questions.label: answerable
questions.rationale: Available settings > On load, run queries for (sec_f95c6bc4f3e886b0) states the default is Current page, so only the visible page's queries run on load and other pages run when navigated to, and gives the five-page, three-chart example of 3 queries versus 15 with All pages.

questions.question: Does a scheduled dashboard delivery reuse cached results, or does it always hit the warehouse?
questions.label: answerable
questions.rationale: Delivery cache (sec_8c63948382a85e7b) states deliveries skip existing cached results and run fresh queries by default, and that the run then creates or updates a cache entry. Use cached results if available (sec_75cc34a85711f2c9) states the option on the delivery form's Dashboard or Chart tab that makes the delivery follow the model cache policy instead.

questions.question: I set up an alert that fires when results change, but nothing came through on the first run. Is that expected?
questions.label: answerable
questions.rationale: Alert condition types (sec_3ae6c459a2cbb3e0) states that for Results have changed and Results have stayed the same there is no previous result on the very first run, so the condition evaluates to false, the first run establishes a baseline, and alerts can fire starting on the second run.

questions.question: What are the rules for naming a dashboard page's identifier, and are any names off limits?
questions.label: answerable
questions.rationale: Advanced page settings > Page key (sec_c125c6a10ea47139) states the key must be unique across pages, contain only letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores, not exceed 40 characters, and not be one of the reserved system values it lists (chat, download, drill, edit, layout, monitor, move, performance, preview, publish, run, save-as, schedules, share, themes, transfer), with a validation error blocking save otherwise.

questions.question: We have our own sales territory boundaries. Can I plot them on an Omni map instead of using countries or US states?
questions.label: answerable
questions.rationale: Region maps > Custom Regions (sec_75389b2af512053c) states you set the region type to Custom and supply region data from a URL complying with GeoJSON or TileJSON, and lists the fields to fill in: Source type, Source URL, Source layer (TileJSON only), and Region property.

questions.question: While I'm viewing a dashboard as another user, can I test their downloads and see what their scheduled deliveries would contain?
questions.label: answerable
questions.rationale: View As basics (sec_d7247e39835b3e60) states View As swaps user attributes and access grants only, and explicitly excludes downloads (not available while viewing as another user), scheduled delivery previews (deliveries run as their owner), and role-based connection restrictions.

questions.question: My Google Sheets schedule was set to add new rows each run, but after I pivoted the query that option disappeared. What happened?
questions.label: answerable
questions.rationale: Delivering pivoted data (sec_b63c60eb795d41ea) states that because pivoted column structure is tied to pivot dimension position, only Overwrite and Create new sheet are supported for pivoted data: Append is unavailable when creating a schedule on a pivoted query, and an existing schedule is switched to Overwrite when the query changes to include pivots.

questions.question: A scheduled delivery failed overnight. Who gets told about it, and what do I do in Omni to send that delivery again?
questions.label: answerable
questions.rationale: Failed delivery notifications (sec_77aaca35c61c0821) states the delivery is marked Failed on the Deliveries page and the delivery's creator receives an email. External destinations (sec_73cef8740f6ad086) gives the re-send step: after checking credentials and the destination's availability, manually retry the delivery from the Deliveries page in Omni.

questions.question: We put a dashboard on an office TV with auto-refresh on. How is the refresh interval measured, and does refreshing keep going while the browser tab sits in the background?
questions.label: partial
questions.rationale: Available settings > Auto-refresh (sec_315c7a17a9ba262f) states the Refresh every interval runs from the time the dashboard is opened until it is closed, gives the 9:36AM/10:36AM example, and notes that manually stopping queries disables auto-refresh until the page is refreshed. Nothing in the corpus states what happens when the browser tab is backgrounded or inactive; searches for background tab, inactive tab and similar wording return no passage on refresh behavior.

questions.question: How do I get a deleted dashboard back, and how do I get rid of one for good so nobody can restore it?
questions.label: partial
questions.rationale: Restoring documents from the trash (sec_27b8cd97a0c15b13) gives the restore arrow procedure and notes that content older than the Trash visibility window is hidden from the Trash; Requirements (sec_07dbd7f6e5cf7579) gives the Editor/Manager/Owner permission needed. No section states how to permanently delete or purge an archived document so it can no longer be restored; searching for permanent deletion and purge returns nothing on content documents.

questions.question: What kinds of data break a Sankey chart, and how many nodes can one render before it stops being usable?
questions.label: partial
questions.rationale: Limitations (sec_111c30c7ff4b4916) states cycles are unsupported and gives the exact circular-reference error text, and Troubleshooting (sec_bea8e3871168ea72) covers the data-shape problems. Data structure (sec_d2cc45c7774595fb) only advises a 'manageable number of nodes' for readability; no section gives a node count or rendering ceiling.

questions.question: How do I let dashboard viewers change how many items a Top N chart shows, and what is the largest N they can pick?
questions.label: partial
questions.rationale: Control types > Top N limit controls (sec_59a8b631b250cf96) describes creating the control and mapping it to an existing Top N field, and warns it silently does nothing if the field isn't in the query and breaks the tile if the mapped field isn't a Top N field. Letting viewers change N on a dashboard (sec_976cbdd04c1010df) points to the same control. The Top N Limitations section (sec_872f59f90dfe65cd) covers ties, single-measure ranking and nesting, but no passage states a maximum value for N.

questions.question: What choices do I get for how a dashboard container behaves on a phone, and at what screen width does the mobile layout kick in?
questions.label: partial
questions.rationale: Controlling mobile behavior (sec_8e109906ea9334c9) lists the On mobile options Auto, Stack vertically, Wrap items, Keep layout and Hide, with which container types each applies to. No section states the pixel width or breakpoint at which Omni switches to the mobile layout, nor whether it can be configured; searches for breakpoint, screen width and viewport width return nothing on dashboards.

questions.question: How do I roll a workbook back to an earlier state, and how far back does that history go?
questions.label: partial
questions.rationale: Workbook versions (sec_c9fc51241ea3aab3) states you open File > Version History to see all changes and restore a previous version, and that the panel covers the workbook only, not the workbook model or dashboard. No passage states how long versions are retained or how many are kept; searches for version retention wording return nothing.

questions.question: If a viewer clicks into a chart to cross-filter a dashboard, do those selections carry through to downloads and to a scheduled delivery of the same dashboard?
questions.label: partial
questions.rationale: Cross-filtering > Limitations (sec_7db14a69a28ea9ad) states explicitly that downloads do not apply cross-filter selections, alongside the null, custom SQL, linked tile and raw SQL tile limitations. Nothing in the corpus states whether a cross-filter selection is carried into a scheduled delivery; the deliveries pages never mention cross-filters.

questions.question: How many email domains can we allow for deliveries, and can an entry cover every subdomain of a company at once?
questions.label: partial
questions.rationale: Adding domains to the allowlist (sec_4397f7bb5b03df53) states up to 1,000 domains can be configured, shows the example.com entry format, and describes the impact preview that blocks saving while existing schedules would break. No passage states whether wildcard or subdomain-spanning entries are accepted; searching the allowlist pages for wildcard patterns returns nothing.

questions.question: Which filters can I use to narrow a content search, and does the search look inside a dashboard's tiles or only at its title and metadata?
questions.label: partial
questions.rationale: Refining results with facets (sec_87544cdc8fefd904) lists the facets creator, in, label, type, favorited, verified and hub with examples, and states they can be combined. No section states what content search actually indexes, so the question of whether tile or chart contents are searched has no supporting passage; searches for index, indexed and full-text on the search page return nothing.

questions.question: Can I send a scheduled dashboard to a Microsoft Teams channel?
questions.label: not_covered
questions.rationale: Destinations (sec_8875db79b5c26571) enumerates the supported delivery destinations as Email, Google Sheets, Amazon S3, SFTP, Slack and Webhook, and no section anywhere mentions Microsoft Teams as a destination or integration. Searching for teams and msteams across the corpus returns only an unrelated support-agent example. A retriever will return the destinations table and the Slack delivery pages.

questions.question: Can I export a dashboard as a PowerPoint deck, one slide per tile, for a board meeting?
questions.label: not_covered
questions.rationale: The dashboard download page (sec_0550f7f04c327237) documents File > Download with formats PDF, PNG, XLSX and CSV and options such as paper size and single-column arrangement; tab downloads (sec_0b7206e58a7b0abd) cover CSV, XLSX and JSON. No section mentions PowerPoint or pptx output. A retriever will return the download and delivery pages.

questions.question: Can I pin a note or callout to a specific data point on a chart so viewers see why that spike happened?
questions.label: not_covered
questions.rationale: The corpus covers chart subtitles and descriptions (sec_0c2b91af4521b5c7), query text items (sec_c3c36e4757a780c4), Markdown text tiles (sec_2244b4a42fe9bb0f) and reference lines on axes, but no section describes annotating a chart at a data point or leaving comments on a chart. The only annotation hits are the app inspector sending annotated images to the Omni Agent. A retriever will return the chart editing and text tile pages.

questions.question: Can I save a content search so I can rerun it later, or get notified when new content matches it?
questions.label: not_covered
questions.rationale: The content search page covers accessing search (sec_ea8d1171a605e5be), the facet list (sec_87544cdc8fefd904) and facet examples (sec_3deea85ffd8a49b2), with no mention of saving a search, search history, or alerting on search results; a corpus-wide search for saved search and search history returns nothing. A retriever will return the search and label pages.

questions.question: Does Omni flag when a chart palette isn't distinguishable for colorblind viewers, or offer a simulator to check it?
questions.label: not_covered
questions.rationale: Color configuration (sec_357b81aef064a118, sec_02f08108d564d9dc, sec_61b039360a9e50e5) and the chart palette pages cover built-in and custom palettes, gradients and dimension colors, but no section mentions colorblind safety, contrast checking, or a vision simulator; searching for colorblind and deuteran across the whole corpus returns zero results. A retriever will return the color configuration and palette pages.

questions.question: Will an Excel file with VBA macros keep working after I import it into a spreadsheet tab?
questions.label: not_covered
questions.rationale: Importing existing CSVs and XLSX files (sec_1e0168dbe9d001a6), How it works > Limitations (sec_bd9bb3f924e78f1c) and Excel differences (sec_fd1161101cac9df6) describe formula parity, hotkeys and the fact that spreadsheet data can't be used elsewhere, but no passage mentions macros or VBA; a corpus-wide macro search returns only dbt macros. A retriever will return the spreadsheet tab import and limitation sections.

questions.question: Can I select a batch of dashboards and apply the same label to all of them in one go?
questions.label: not_covered
questions.rationale: Labels (sec_978b497aae131734), Applying labels (sec_993dddc438ff828b) and Managing labels (sec_07b2d743b283deed) describe applying a label from within a document and managing labels in settings, one document at a time. No section describes multi-select or bulk label application; searches for bulk and multi-select on the organize and search pages return nothing. A retriever will return the label sections.

questions.question: Can I download my activity list as a CSV to review what I worked on last quarter?
questions.label: not_covered
questions.rationale: The activity page covers the type filter (sec_7964a88f4f606cc2), the Today/Yesterday/This week/Older grouping, and loading up to 1,000 entries at a time (sec_1f749caa4e66ed99), but no section mentions exporting activity or downloading it in any format. A retriever will return the activity page sections.

questions.question: Can I stamp a confidential watermark across dashboard PDFs that people download?
questions.label: not_covered
questions.rationale: The download options table (sec_0550f7f04c327237) lists file name, format, paper size, expand tables, single-column arrangement, hide title and data formatting, with no watermark option, and a corpus-wide search for watermark returns only unrelated Omni Agent help text. A retriever will return the download page and theming pages.

questions.question: Our delivery recipients are in different countries. Can each recipient get the report rendered in their own timezone?
questions.label: not_covered
questions.rationale: Dynamic content > Date and time (sec_e29026e86e29c895) states date and time references reflect the delivery's schedule timezone, a single per-schedule setting, and Schedule delivery times (sec_ecee23cb901eabd3) covers only approximate send times. Email personalization (sec_8e0b442cdfd507c4, sec_8fef07ad984613c8) covers per-recipient data through user attributes but says nothing about timezone. No passage describes a per-recipient timezone. A retriever will return the delivery, dynamic content and timezone override pages.

questions.question: Is there a cap on how many schedules and alerts a single dashboard can have?
questions.label: not_covered
questions.rationale: The deliveries overview covers destinations, schedule times, alert conditions, delivery access and caching, and states only that a delivery can have one destination (sec_8875db79b5c26571). No section states a maximum number of deliveries per dashboard or per instance. A retriever will return the deliveries index and access sections.

questions.question: If I pivot on a dimension with hundreds of distinct values, will the results table show every pivot column or cut off at some point?
questions.label: conflicting
questions.rationale: Column and pivot limits (sec_dd46d9ea9255dfab) states pivots are limited to 200 columns while any number of measures is supported. Section inj_pivot_columns_unlimited on the same page states there is no cap on pivot columns and that the 200 figure applies only to CSV downloads, directly contradicting sec_dd46d9ea9255dfab.

questions.question: How many pages can I add to one dashboard before Omni stops me?
questions.label: conflicting
questions.rationale: Adding pages (sec_673ab4709c9a6f4d) states dashboards can have up to 15 pages. Section inj_dashboard_pages_unlimited, on the same page, states no maximum page count is enforced and that Omni does not block the fifteenth page or any page after it, contradicting sec_673ab4709c9a6f4d.

questions.question: When a delivery fails, does Omni retry it on a backoff schedule, or does the run just get marked failed and wait for the next occurrence?
questions.label: conflicting
questions.rationale: Retrying failed deliveries (sec_85ff6c957b0aa8ae) states Omni attempts each delivery once per occurrence, does not automatically retry a failure, and simply runs again at the next scheduled interval. Section inj_delivery_auto_retry states Omni retries up to three times with exponential backoff before marking the delivery failed, contradicting sec_85ff6c957b0aa8ae.

questions.question: Do I have to move everything out of a folder before I can delete it, or does deleting take the contents with it?
questions.label: conflicting
questions.rationale: Folders > Deleting folders (sec_f885a91fef4f47dc) states folders can only be deleted if they're empty, and that Editors can delete empty folders they created while Managers can delete any empty folder they can access. Section inj_folder_delete_recursive states folders need not be emptied and that deletion removes nested folders, dashboards and workbooks along with the parent, contradicting sec_f885a91fef4f47dc.

questions.question: Which Omni API endpoints will reject a Personal Access Token and require an organization key instead?
questions.label: answerable
questions.rationale: sec_af49e60d70455186 (PAT endpoint limitations) enumerates them: document export, document import, create email-only user, bulk create mail-only users, and all SCIM user and user group endpoints, and states an Organization API key is required for those.

questions.question: Can a script tell an Omni CLI authentication failure apart from a mistyped subcommand by looking at the exit code?
questions.label: answerable
questions.rationale: sec_c73de4b4b9c4b781 states the CLI uses only exit codes 0 and 1, that an API error, an authentication or config-resolution error, and a local usage error such as an unrecognized subcommand all exit 1, and says explicitly you cannot branch on the exit code to tell failure types apart.

questions.question: If OMNI_API_TOKEN is exported in my shell and I also pass --token on the command line, which one does the Omni CLI use?
questions.label: answerable
questions.rationale: sec_c50b85ed3b217760 documents OMNI_API_TOKEN as overriding the active profile's token but itself being overridden by --token, so the flag wins. The same precedence pattern is spelled out for OMNI_BASE_URL and OMNI_OUTPUT_FORMAT.

questions.question: What happens to the users and groups assigned to a custom role in Omni if that role is deleted?
questions.label: answerable
questions.rationale: sec_01c7d463d265db5a (Deleting custom roles) states that deleting a custom role reassigns all affected users and groups to the tier's base role, using the example that deleting a role resolving to Querier reverts assignees to the base Querier role.

questions.question: Before my team can use Notion with the Omni Agent, who has to switch it on and does each person still have to do something themselves?
questions.label: answerable
questions.rationale: sec_6a499adb67fa32cb states Organization Admin permissions are required to enable the Notion integration under Settings > Integrations > AI Integrations. sec_db95d9cfe9bf8c53 and sec_c2d856b50ae80284 state that after it is enabled, every individual user must still connect their own Notion account from user settings or the Agent connector menu.

questions.question: Does Omni support automatic user provisioning through SCIM when we sign in with Google Workspace?
questions.label: answerable
questions.rationale: sec_442676374dd417c8 (Limitations) states that user and user group provisioning via SCIM is not currently supported for Google Workspace. sec_0e2b9b68b47e8571 on the authentication index corroborates by listing SCIM support only for Microsoft Entra, Okta, and Rippling.

questions.question: I only build a handful of dbt models in my dev schema, so most of my virtual schema tables are missing in Omni. What is the recommended fix?
questions.label: answerable
questions.rationale: sec_11370b120294888c describes what happens when only some dbt models are built in a dev schema, and sec_ccf921d4db82f8f4 gives the recommended answer: enable the Enable deferral checkbox on the dev environment so Omni falls back to production builds for models not built in dev. sec_4f545bd43d65cf59 notes dbt clone as the complementary alternative.

questions.question: How do I get Omni audit logs landing in my own S3 bucket, and what object key or folder structure do the delivered log files use in that bucket?
questions.label: partial
questions.rationale: sec_c520e48c160cbb92, sec_ffecc64d01f87753 and sec_3e4442fab319fb8f cover the setup: contact Omni support to enable audit logs, hold AWS permissions to manage IAM roles, and hand Omni support the IAM role name. The object layout has no supporting passage: neither the S3 page nor the audit logs index (sec_59a106f3a89a9366, sec_b69c0365aeca8bf6) states an object key prefix, folder or date partitioning scheme, or file naming convention for the delivered JSON batches.

questions.question: How do I report a security vulnerability in Omni, and what payment does Omni offer for a valid report?
questions.label: partial
questions.rationale: sec_30924bc7e3696984 gives the reporting process: email security@omni.co with a description and reproduction steps, excluding PII and PCI, and sec_2a8d74b5a81db83f promises acknowledgment within 3 business days and legal protection. Nothing in the corpus states any monetary reward, bounty, or payment tier; a search for bounty, reward, and monetary returns only unrelated modeling and demo sections.

questions.question: Which git providers can I connect an Omni model to, and how large can that repository be before Omni refuses to clone it?
questions.label: partial
questions.rationale: sec_8801ec21f9cf3773 and sec_9190643e4baaab51 list the supported providers, GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, and Azure DevOps, along with the authentication options, which answers the first part. No section states a repository size limit or any clone size constraint; the settings reference (sec_34832d9a9fdf61f2 and following) covers branch, path, webhook, and authentication settings with no size figure.

questions.question: How do I control which custom role wins when a user matches several in the same tier, and how many custom roles can one organization define?
questions.label: partial
questions.rationale: sec_277733512ac4fa41 answers the first part: priority follows the order roles appear in the list from the top, with the base role highest by default, and the order can be changed in Settings > Roles. No passage states a maximum number of custom roles; the creation, editing, duplication, and deletion sections impose no count limit and a search for a custom role limit or maximum returns nothing.

questions.question: Where do I find the IP addresses Omni uses to reach my warehouse, and how do I restrict which IP ranges can sign in to the Omni app itself?
questions.label: partial
questions.rationale: sec_7c6aa1f8f90e6f9d states Omni's outbound IP addresses are shown on an individual connection's page under Settings > Connections, and sec_20b4deb994c9a4d0 covers allowlisting those IPs on a database, SFTP server, or webhook endpoint. Inbound restriction is unaddressed: no section describes limiting user sign-in or app access to specific source IP ranges, and the authentication pages cover SAML, OIDC, and SCIM with no network-level restriction.

questions.question: Which interface languages does Omni ship with, and how do I supply my own translation for a language that isn't on the list?
questions.label: partial
questions.rationale: sec_09bcaf0bf09da7d9 gives the supported locale table and how the org default works, and sec_109e6beeb89a91bf covers narrowing the choices with Allowed locales, so the first part is answered. Supplying a custom translation has no passage: the page describes only selecting from supported locales at the org, user, and embed levels, with no mechanism for adding or uploading a locale of your own.

questions.question: How many external hosts can I list in the Apps custom source policy, and can I give different folders different host lists?
questions.label: partial
questions.rationale: sec_e4d8d05461ee124e states a custom list accepts up to 25 hosts and explains how to enter them under Settings > Apps. Per-folder scoping is unsupported by any passage: sec_f31f0e4bbfbb3f49 and sec_c3debc73514d1b0b describe the policy as an organization-wide ceiling above per-app Safe domains, and no section describes scoping a host list to a folder.

questions.question: What are my options for installing the Omni CLI on Windows, and is there a package manager install such as winget or Chocolatey?
questions.label: partial
questions.rationale: sec_ecd482793cc78214 lists Windows amd64 as a supported OS and sec_8f6b1c83e986194f covers the GitHub releases download for Windows, so the first part is answered. No Windows package manager is documented: Homebrew (sec_d75c6399a33fa876) is scoped to macOS and Linux, the install script (sec_31177f75136f1511) likewise, and a search for winget, Chocolatey, and Scoop returns nothing in the corpus.

questions.question: What's the right way to authenticate the Omni CLI from a CI pipeline, and how do I make it send its traffic through our corporate HTTP proxy?
questions.label: partial
questions.rationale: sec_5c323fdd5d451390 and sec_264aa3f40b2ba02c answer the first part: use API key authentication for automated workflows and CI/CD or a service account, supplying the key through OMNI_API_TOKEN or omni config init. Proxy configuration has no passage anywhere; the environment variables reference (sec_c50b85ed3b217760) lists token, base URL, output format, and config path variables only, and a search for proxy across the corpus returns nothing.

questions.question: Our dbt project lives in Bitbucket. How do I connect it to Omni's dbt integration?
questions.label: not_covered
questions.rationale: sec_2a401d1fc3b25ed3 on the dbt setup index lists exactly three provider guides, Azure DevOps, GitHub, and GitLab, and there is no dbt setup page for Bitbucket in the corpus. The only Bitbucket pages, sec_9a8099c797d0366f and sec_7e68c7876df716cc, belong to the model git integration, which is a separate integration from dbt. No section states how, or whether, a Bitbucket-hosted dbt project connects. A retriever will return the dbt setup pages and the Bitbucket git pages.

questions.question: Is there an official Go client library for the Omni REST API?
questions.label: not_covered
questions.rationale: A search for Go SDK, golang, and Go client returns zero sections. The only client libraries in the corpus are the Omni Python SDK (sec_45c8d85337df4a64, sec_fc04434b9e99fab0) and the TypeScript embed SDK, and the API index (sec_c38cf96f909fd1f9) points to the CLI and agent skills as the wrappers over the REST API. Nothing states whether a Go library exists.

questions.question: When Omni posts an AI job completion webhook to my endpoint, how can my endpoint verify the request really came from Omni?
questions.label: answerable
questions.rationale: sec_08d3c974fb2bf48f on the Create AI job page states the webhook POST carries X-Omni-Signature-Timestamp and X-Omni-Signature, where the signature is sha256=HMAC(timestamp.body, secret), so the endpoint recomputes the HMAC to verify origin. sec_e03732a72b40ce68 on the embedded AI chat agent guide shows the matching webhookSigningSecret parameter supplied when the job is created, which supplies the shared secret both halves of the check need.

questions.question: Can I see our Omni invoice broken down by user or by connection on the Billing page?
questions.label: not_covered
questions.rationale: The Billing page is fully read, and it describes only three things: that Organization Admin permissions are required (sec_716ca51ae9fffffd), that the Invoices section lists past invoices newest first (sec_d41ed033908f5de1), and where billing contacts are configured (sec_a2bdfd89b25b7a0e). No section states any per-user or per-connection breakdown of an invoice, nor any line-item detail. A retriever will return the billing sections and the Analytics page.

questions.question: Can Omni stream audit log events directly to Splunk or Datadog instead of to object storage?
questions.label: not_covered
questions.rationale: sec_b69c0365aeca8bf6 names exactly three delivery destinations, Amazon S3, Google Cloud Storage, and Azure Blob Storage, and the corpus has one setup page for each. A search for Splunk, Datadog, Log Analytics, and Sumo Logic returns zero sections, so nothing states whether a SIEM or HTTP log endpoint is supported. A retriever will return the audit log destination sections.

questions.question: We use OneLogin as our identity provider. How do I set up SCIM provisioning into Omni from it?
questions.label: not_covered
questions.rationale: sec_0e2b9b68b47e8571 states SCIM support for Microsoft Entra, Okta, and Rippling, and the corpus has SCIM setup pages only for those three. OneLogin appears nowhere in the corpus; a search for OneLogin and JumpCloud returns no authentication sections. Nothing states whether OneLogin SCIM is possible, so a retriever will return the Okta, Entra, and Rippling SCIM pages without answering the question.

questions.question: Can I lock an Omni API key so it only works from our office IP range?
questions.label: not_covered
questions.rationale: The API authentication page covers token types, the Authorization header, expiration, creation, enabling and disabling, rotation, revocation, and introspection, with no source-IP restriction on a token. The only IP allowlisting in the corpus (sec_20b4deb994c9a4d0) is about allowlisting Omni's outbound addresses on a database, SFTP server, or webhook endpoint, which is the opposite direction. No section states whether API keys can be IP-bound.

questions.question: Does the Omni CLI have a dry-run flag so I can preview what a destructive command would change before it runs?
questions.label: not_covered
questions.rationale: A search for dry-run and dry run returns zero sections across the corpus, including the global flags reference and every command group page. The global flags documented are things like token, base URL, and output format, and no section states whether a preview or no-op mode exists. A retriever will return the CLI global flags and command reference pages.

questions.question: How much notice does Omni give before removing an older version of an API endpoint, and how are those removals announced?
questions.label: not_covered
questions.rationale: sec_98f79cafff79d47a and the rest of the versioning page list endpoints by resource with a version and status badge, but state no deprecation policy, no notice period, and no announcement channel for removals. A search for deprecation across the corpus surfaces only specific deprecated features, such as the v0 embed URL format and model-defined skills, never a policy governing API endpoint removal.

questions.question: What is the request-per-minute limit on the Omni API, and can we get it raised?
questions.label: conflicting
questions.rationale: sec_623791593e3544f3 states the limit is 60 requests per minute per API key and that an increase to 500 requests per minute can be requested from Omni Support. inj_api_rate_limit_org_scope on the same page states the limit is 120 requests per minute counted per organization rather than per key, and that increases are not available. The two disagree on the number, the scope the limit is counted against, and whether a raise is possible.

questions.question: When I rotate an Omni API token, does the previous secret keep working for a while or stop immediately?
questions.label: conflicting
questions.rationale: sec_0205182ec857ab44 states rotation generates a new secret while the old secret remains valid for a 24 hour grace period so applications can be updated without downtime. inj_api_token_rotation_immediate on the same page states the old secret is invalidated the moment rotation completes and there is no grace period. They give opposite answers to the same question.

questions.question: How long does an Omni session last when users sign in through OIDC, and can we change that duration?
questions.label: conflicting
questions.rationale: sec_4d5d25e367abd9c9 states OIDC user sessions expire after 24 hours and that this is not currently configurable. inj_oidc_session_configurable on the same page states sessions last 30 days by default and that the window is configurable in Settings > Authentication. The two contradict each other on both the duration and whether it can be changed.

questions.question: How can my host page automatically resize the Omni iframe so it fits the dashboard instead of showing an inner scrollbar?
questions.label: answerable
questions.rationale: sec_54df8ed3dd8d18d4 states Omni emits a size event when a dashboard loads and when an embedded app loads or resizes, allowing the host to adjust the iframe height; sec_673dbc1b4476c9dd gives the width/height payload. sec_e9341fa6bc9bd222 on the consume page shows the postMessage listener that reads event.data.payload.height and sets the frame height.

questions.question: When an eval run scores one of my prompts, what information does the scoring model actually look at?
questions.label: answerable
questions.rationale: sec_0c60f707a8faa145 (How the accuracy judge works > What the judge sees) lists the user prompt, every tool call and its result including generated queries and sampled data, and the AI's final written response, and states the judge does not re-run queries or inspect the live semantic model. sec_831f641818a236ac lists the error classes it checks for.

questions.question: How many eval runs can Omni have going at the same time, and what should I do if I want to start another one?
questions.label: answerable
questions.rationale: sec_1b892a3215473fe7 (Running an eval) states you can have up to two eval runs in progress at once and that you should wait for a run to finish, or cancel it, before starting a third. The same section describes the run flow from the AI Hub, so both halves come from one passage on https://docs.omni.co/ai/evals.

questions.question: Which AI setting will blow up our token bill the fastest if we turn it up?
questions.label: answerable
questions.rationale: sec_88db05d0523aac35 rates analyze_configuration.model and analyze_configuration.thinking as High cost, noting smartest is multiple times more expensive per token than standard and that high thinking on analyze compounds fastest. sec_b4b62c74c6ee4e94 (Max quality) states outright that smartest plus thinking: high on analyze_configuration is the single biggest cost multiplier.

questions.question: Our embedded customers are in France and Germany. How do we get the Omni interface to show in their own language?
questions.label: answerable
questions.rationale: sec_9a75d6c1cd807cb4 (Embedded users) states you pass a locale user attribute in the embed configuration, that it behaves like a user-level locale when it matches an entry in Allowed locales, and that it falls back to the organization-level Locale otherwise. sec_09bcaf0bf09da7d9 lists the supported locale codes including fr and de, and sec_109e6beeb89a91bf covers the Allowed locales setting.

questions.question: Why does one question in the Omni Agent show up as several rows of credit usage, some of them with no prompt text at all?
questions.label: answerable
questions.rationale: sec_2d6f49b36fe93c47 (Common questions) answers both halves: Omni's AI is agentic and a single prompt fires multiple tool calls that are each logged as their own row, and the blank-prompt rows are those intermediate tool calls, part of the AI's internal reasoning rather than anything the user typed.

questions.question: I'm wiring my own chat UI to Omni for our embedded customers. How do I make sure each query runs with that specific customer's permissions and not my API key's?
questions.label: answerable
questions.rationale: sec_f4aa00cb5d9474c3 shows passing the embed user's ID as the userId query parameter on Create AI job and warns that userId only works with Organization API keys, not Personal Access Tokens. sec_7b59a7f1e33c3ae9 and sec_74c850836fc84ea7 give the MCP equivalent, the required X-MCP-User-ID header plus X-MCP-User-Required. sec_61cbc40817a241b0 confirms both paths enforce access grants, row-level security and topic restrictions for that user.

questions.question: We keep a separate embed secret for prod, staging and each partner integration. How do we add another secret, and is there a ceiling on how many can be active at once?
questions.label: partial
questions.rationale: sec_998cd051f69a4716 (Creating secrets) gives the add flow: Settings > Embed > Admin, Add Secret, name it in the dialog, and sec_406a94e74e57830a frames the page as create, view, edit and delete for the organization. On the ceiling, sec_96351c8ef6a6419c says only that Omni allows multiple active secrets at the same time; nowhere does a passage give a maximum count an organization can hold, so the second half has no supporting text.

questions.question: We cap AI credits per customer using embed entity groups. How does the entity group default interact with a per-group limit, and does anyone get emailed when a group is close to burning through its allowance?
questions.label: partial
questions.rationale: The first half is answered by sec_44a3ae9fa6586bce, which describes a default applying to all entity groups plus group-specific limits, and by sec_299882dcf6d55b4f on setting the default and sec_fd6aa326bd551948, which states a group-level limit overrides the entity group default. For the second half, sec_29eabd475fd0cb20 documents 75% and 100% email notifications only for the organization-level hard cap and less-expensive-model thresholds, sent to Organization Admins; nothing ties a notification to an entity group approaching its limit.

questions.question: After an eval run on a branch, how do I put it side by side with the baseline, and how do I get the per-prompt results out as a file to attach to our release ticket?
questions.label: partial
questions.rationale: The comparison half is covered by sec_ae3238f4708809f9, which describes comparing a branch run to a main baseline, limits comparison to two runs of the same prompt set, and lists the per-prompt accuracy, credits and duration columns. Nothing in the corpus describes exporting, downloading or otherwise extracting eval results to a file; sec_8357fb5863a3d76a only covers viewing results in the run view and archiving a completed run.

questions.question: We want session replay on our embedded Omni pages. Which replay tools can Omni feed, and how long does the recorded session data stick around?
questions.label: partial
questions.rationale: The supported-tools half is answered by sec_5413fcd222fa4fe9, which names FullStory and LogRocket, with setup in sec_87e2f7fcb09aa432 and the canvas-rendering caveat in sec_ffca03373117a220. No passage states any retention period for the session data these integrations capture; sec_02774f73f4787027 only says that removing an integration disables it for new sessions while existing sessions may keep sending data until they expire.

questions.question: On a vanity domain I can check the __omni_embed_vanity_session cookie before logging a user in. What is that cookie for, and how do I push its expiry out so it doesn't drift away from the real session?
questions.label: partial
questions.rationale: The purpose and reading of the cookie are covered by sec_6589697e7c539ec1, sec_e7a0ccde4cc50e08 and sec_f0483332a4de280c, including the domain-scope rule and the code for checking presence. sec_e7a0ccde4cc50e08 says the Max-Age should be updated through a session refresh call, but no section anywhere in the corpus documents that refresh call, its endpoint, or how to invoke it.

questions.question: We want a routine posting a Monday morning summary to a Slack channel. How do we set that up, and what happens if one Monday's run fails, does it retry?
questions.label: partial
questions.rationale: Setup and Slack delivery are covered by sec_c82e3f6df832dec0 (ask the agent for a recurring prompt, name a Slack channel, Slack delivery needs a connected workspace) and sec_a327dac4af99139f (results delivered as text by email or to Slack). sec_4b10a23990aa401e covers managing, pausing and manually triggering a routine. No passage states what happens when a scheduled routine run fails, whether Omni retries, or whether anyone is notified.

questions.question: We're standardizing on skills across the analytics team. What are the field limits when writing one, and is there a ceiling on how many skills an organization can have?
questions.label: partial
questions.rationale: The per-skill limits are covered by sec_71ab12cf128a5632, the Skill properties table, which lists each property, whether it is required, and its maximum character count (for example a 48-character Name). No passage states any limit on the number of skills an organization or user can create; sec_d81e2464de7792ed only covers who can see and edit existing skills.

questions.question: We're pointing Omni's AI at Snowflake Cortex. Which models can we pick, and what warehouse size should we size for the inference calls?
questions.label: partial
questions.rationale: The model half is answered by sec_fbb53f66d4f8ee42, which lists the supported query models (Claude 4.5 Sonnet, 4 Sonnet, 4.5 Opus, 4 Opus, 3.7 Sonnet, 3.5 Sonnet) and text models (Claude 4.5 Haiku, 3.5 Haiku). The Snowflake-side requirements in sec_657af165ad04ed94 and sec_140ff9d491950032 cover the CORTEX_USER role, cross-region inference and network policies, but no passage mentions warehouse sizing or any compute requirement for Cortex inference.

questions.question: We run a staging and a production Omni instance for our embed. How does model and dashboard content move between them, and how do we carry our AI prompt sets over so we can rerun the same eval on production?
questions.label: partial
questions.rationale: Model and content promotion are covered in detail: sec_509a8d2bbde7f537 and sec_98ed147bd6fc34de on Git Follower Mode for the model, sec_15867b369f35775b and sec_d87a250812f543d7 on the Content Migration API for dashboards and workbooks, which explicitly says Git Follower covers the model only. Nothing states how prompt sets or eval runs move between instances; sec_ceb16e6113c4ee59 scopes a prompt set to a single Omni model and no passage describes copying, exporting or migrating one.

questions.question: Our CI needs to start an eval run against a model branch without anyone opening the AI Hub. Is there a programmatic way to launch one and then read the per-prompt results back?
questions.label: answerable
questions.rationale: sec_230c2aa43eb46671 documents POST /v1/ai/eval/runs, which creates and starts a run against an existing prompt set, enqueues one agentic job per prompt, begins executing immediately and returns the run with its initial per-prompt result rows. sec_98fbc7f66e3f0747 documents GET /v1/ai/eval/runs/{runId}, which returns the run with every per-prompt result row including agentic job state and scoring data, so both halves are served by the eval API.

questions.question: Does Omni state a conformance level for screen reader and keyboard accessibility in embedded dashboards, for our procurement review?
questions.label: not_covered
questions.rationale: Searched for screen reader, accessibility, WCAG, VPAT, Section 508 and ARIA across the corpus. The only hits are unrelated uses of the word (for example COS/COT calculation pages and access-control docs). The embed limitations, best practices and security pages state browser, cookie and keyboard-shortcut behavior but nothing about assistive technology conformance. A retriever will return embed/limitations and administration/security, neither of which answers it.

questions.question: Can we provision our embed users and map them into entity groups through SCIM from Okta, the way we do for our internal Omni users?
questions.label: not_covered
questions.rationale: Searched for SCIM, provisioning and directory sync. SCIM is documented only for standard authentication users under administration/authentication (Entra, Okta). The embed docs state the opposite mechanism and never mention SCIM: sec_d9110f876445c1af says embed users are provisioned programmatically through the embedded application, sec_c0e07081b6d37d18 says entities are provisioned programmatically via the entity URL parameter, and sec_3c7e59ad145899a7 gives 2-step SSO generate-session as the way to pre-create an embed user. No passage states whether SCIM can or cannot reach embed users.

questions.question: What's the largest file a user can attach to an Omni Agent conversation?
questions.label: not_covered
questions.rationale: Searched for file upload, attachment, file size, MB and limit. sec_93a40331f448a6c4 documents the File uploads AI setting that allows users to upload files and images in chat, and sec_e07d0f9c160f71be shows a skill that asks the user to upload a CSV, but neither states a size limit, and no other passage gives one. A retriever will return the AI features settings page and the skills page, which discuss uploads without stating the ceiling.

questions.question: Can Omni call a webhook in our application when an embed session is created or expires, so we can keep our own session table in step?
questions.label: not_covered
questions.rationale: Searched for webhook, callback and notification alongside session. The only documented webhooks in the corpus are on AI jobs (sec_e03732a72b40ce68 and the Create AI job page) and delivery schedules. The embed sessions page (sec_85df9ca52d443fd7, sec_5d204221daa74898, sec_54492b41b7cf205c) covers viewing and deleting sessions in the UI only, and the audit log event types page carries embed membership created/deleted events but no session events and no push mechanism.

questions.question: Can we run the Omni MCP server inside our own network instead of connecting clients to the hosted endpoint?
questions.label: not_covered
questions.rationale: Searched for self-host, on-premise, local server, stdio and docker in relation to MCP. Every MCP passage points clients at the Omni instance URL over HTTP: sec_7b59a7f1e33c3ae9 configures the client against https://<instance>/mcp/https, and the per-client pages (Claude Desktop, Cursor, ChatGPT, VS Code, Codex) and ai/mcp/authentication all describe connecting to that hosted endpoint with OAuth or an API key. No section states whether a locally run server is possible.

questions.question: Is there an audit log event recorded every time someone submits a prompt to the Omni Agent, so we can review AI activity alongside our other audit events?
questions.label: not_covered
questions.rationale: Read the full audit log event types page. It documents API request, query context, query execution, dashboard download, user invite, connection, organization action, role, content permission and embed membership events, and contains no AI, prompt, chat or conversation event type. AI activity is instead surfaced through the credit tracking dashboard and prompt logs in Analytics (sec_26c1b6650aaed5aa, sec_a7665d98b43d0a95), neither of which is an audit log event. No passage states whether an audit event exists for prompts.

questions.question: How many embed entity groups can one Omni instance hold before we need to think about splitting instances?
questions.label: not_covered
questions.rationale: Searched for entity group limits, maximum and scaling. sec_66beee95e90c4837 states a folder and group are created automatically whenever Omni detects a new entity value, and sec_c581fcbc7a33c43a describes the entity group list, but no passage gives a maximum count or any guidance on scale limits. The deployment guides under guides/deployment discuss choosing single versus multi-instance for other reasons and never cite an entity ceiling.

questions.question: Can we point Omni's AI at one exact model build, such as a dated OpenAI model identifier, instead of whatever the default model dropdown resolves to?
questions.label: answerable
questions.rationale: sec_e29aa49afa47fdc6 states that with OpenAI as the provider you can specify custom model identifiers for models not in the default dropdowns, including newly released and fine-tuned models. sec_d295afce4885bad9 gives the steps: pick Custom model identifier in the Smartest, Standard or Fastest dropdown and enter the identifier, with gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09 as one of the worked examples, and notes custom models default to a 400,000 token context window. sec_7d94062b6135431a confirms the Custom model setting is OpenAI-only.

questions.question: If I delete an old embed secret, do URLs signed with it stop working straight away, or is there a window where they keep authenticating?
questions.label: conflicting
questions.rationale: sec_b600cc43635c62d8 states that deleting a secret immediately invalidates all embed URLs signed with it and that existing sessions receive 403 Forbidden errors, and sec_96351c8ef6a6419c repeats that deletion is immediate and warns that skipping verification breaks in-flight sessions. Section inj_embed_secret_delete_grace asserts a 24-hour grace period during which the deleted secret keeps authenticating and says verification before deletion is unnecessary, directly contradicting sec_b600cc43635c62d8.

questions.question: Is there a maximum number of prompts I can put in one prompt set, or can I load a few hundred questions into a single set?
questions.label: conflicting
questions.rationale: sec_ceb16e6113c4ee59 states a prompt set is a reusable list of up to 25 natural-language prompts, sec_2bc6c6547166a031 refers to the 25-prompt limit when adding prompts, and sec_78f0700a159ace69 advises starting with 10-15 and expanding toward the 25-prompt cap. Section inj_prompt_set_no_cap asserts there is no cap and that several-hundred-prompt sets are supported, contradicting sec_ceb16e6113c4ee59.

questions.question: When I write an expected answer for an eval prompt, does the AI being tested get to see it while it works?
questions.label: conflicting
questions.rationale: sec_c5590c289505d361 states that expected behavior is shown only to the judge and that the AI being evaluated never sees it, so it cannot steer toward the expected answer. Section inj_expected_behavior_visible_to_ai asserts the expected behavior is passed to the evaluated AI along with the prompt so it can aim at the reference answer, directly contradicting sec_c5590c289505d361.

questions.question: If I never set ai_settings on a model, does the agent self-check its analysis before I see the answer?
questions.label: conflicting
questions.rationale: sec_26fa5a07d33c7185 gives the Balanced profile as Omni's out-of-the-box behavior, what you get when ai_settings is unset, and its YAML sets validate_analysis: disabled. sec_44692e9068266675 reinforces this by describing flipping validate_analysis to enabled as a change on top of Balanced. Section inj_balanced_validate_analysis_enabled asserts the Balanced default has validate_analysis enabled, contradicting sec_26fa5a07d33c7185.

questions.question: If a later embed login request leaves out a connection, does the user keep the access an earlier request in the same session gave them?
questions.label: conflicting
questions.rationale: sec_0eec4dffcc5a3fb7 states the connectionRoles on the latest request is the source of truth, that a role can be downgraded by a later request, that it can be removed entirely if the later request does not mention the connection, and warns that on a multi-iframe page a request omitting connectionRoles overwrites access granted by the others. Section inj_connection_roles_accumulate asserts roles accumulate and are never removed or downgraded, and that omitting connectionRoles on secondary iframes is safe, directly contradicting sec_0eec4dffcc5a3fb7.

questions.question: Once the MCP server is switched on for our org, are the direct getData and runQuery tools available right away, or is that a separate opt-in?
questions.label: conflicting
questions.rationale: sec_df796665530f7644 states that Single shot query generation, which exposes getData and runQuery, is Disabled by default, in contrast with the neighbouring settings that sec_d5d6f181d2bd29ce, sec_fd9f09de5391e48e and sec_4a11ceaf934b614c each mark Enabled by default. Section inj_mcp_single_shot_default_on asserts single shot query generation is enabled by default in every organization with no extra toggle, contradicting sec_df796665530f7644.

questions.question: I asked the agent to project revenue six months out and it drew a line. Which statistical method is behind that projection, and can I get an upper and lower band around it?
questions.label: partial
questions.rationale: The forecasting page explains how to prompt the agent, that it uses an internal deterministic forecasting library, and how multi-period forecasts are stitched together from daily granularity. No section anywhere names the method (no mention of ARIMA, Prophet, exponential smoothing or seasonality) and no section describes prediction intervals, confidence bands, or any uncertainty output, so the second half of the question has no supporting passage.

questions.question: Our analysts keep seeing the AI pop up a learning summary mid-conversation. What is it allowed to write into the model, and can we suppress just those proactive pop-ups while keeping the manual brain-icon flow available?
questions.label: partial
questions.rationale: The Learn from conversation page lists what the flow can generate (field descriptions and labels, ai_context annotations, synonyms, new dimensions and measures, view-level context) and describes auto-learn as enabled by default for all organizations, with the manual brain-icon review flow alongside it. The only documented control is the ai_settings disabled_tools parameter, whose learn_from_conversation value disables the whole tool; no section describes suppressing the proactive auto-learn summaries while leaving the manual flow available, so that half of the question has no supporting passage.

questions.question: I want our brand colors available in the chart color picker, and I need to know what a chart does once it has more series than the palette has colors?
questions.label: partial
questions.rationale: The custom chart palettes page gives the full create, edit and delete flow including pasting comma-separated hex codes, and the index page explains where palettes surface in the Options panel and that they apply to color faceting on X/Y charts. Nothing in the palette pages or the visualization docs says what happens when the number of color-faceted series exceeds the number of colors in the palette, so the overflow behavior has no supporting passage.

questions.question: We want Blobby emoji in our dashboard tile titles, and we also want to add our own company mascot images to the same picker. How do both work?
questions.label: partial
questions.rationale: The emoji settings page covers the Blobby catalog, the :emoji-name: syntax, the surfaces where custom emoji render including dashboard tile titles, and the beta and white-label restrictions. It describes the catalog as Omni-provided and gives no upload or authoring path for an organization's own emoji images, so the second half of the question is unsupported.

questions.question: As an org admin I want to look at Omni through a specific analyst's eyes to check an access grant, and then get back to my own account. What are the steps on both ends?
questions.label: partial
questions.rationale: The impersonation page gives the entry path (Settings > Users, open the user, Impersonate user at the bottom of their details page), the Organization Admin requirement, the rule that admins can't impersonate admins, pending-invite behavior, and the contrast with View As. No section states how to leave an impersonation session or whether it ends on its own, so the return half has no supporting passage.

questions.question: We report into Germany and the US from one model. How do I get thousands separators and currency symbols to follow each viewer's region, and how do I get dates to follow their region too so Germans see day-first?
questions.label: partial
questions.rationale: The default_numeric_locale model parameter covers the number half directly: it sets thousands and decimal delimiters and the default currency symbol, and it can be driven dynamically from a user attribute for multi-regional organizations. There is no equivalent locale-driven date parameter; date formatting is only documented as per-field presets and advanced field-level formatting in the results table, with nothing that resolves a date format from the viewer's region.
